subject: Semi circle pie chart using coord_polar

messages.author: 7a4643314f548571
messages.subject: Semi circle pie chart using coord_polar
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering whether there is a way to create a semi circular pie chart (not by choice..) in ggplot (that does not involve creating a fake category with white fill on the bottom using the "start = " option)?

I am looking for something like this

http://www.highcharts.com/demo/pie-semi-circle/

with the labels inside or outside the pie chart, but the donut hole is not important.

I tried with a dummy category with white fill, placed on the bottom using "start = (pi * 90) / 180" or so, but I could not get it to zoom in (coord_map, I believe) and thus crop out the white part afterwards, which meant I could not place the result in a matrix of figures (which is required to automate the process to be used with multiple datasets).

Thanks so much for any advice you can provide in advance!
Mehmet.
